full_judgment: 15. We have been supplied with an unreported decision of the Appellate Division in the case of Abdul Motaleb vs Md Ershad Ali and others in Civil Appeal No. 28 of 1990. In the said decision the question of amendment of the plaint was considered. The plaintiffs suit for simple declaration of title was converted to a suit for declaration of title and for Khas possession by amendment of the plaint following the alleged dispossession of the plaintiffs from the suit land during the pendency of the suit. Thereafter another prayer for amendment of the plaint was made stating, inter alia, that as he had already claimed recovery of possession upon payment of ad valorem Court-fee on the value of his claimed share in the suit plot, the decree would be more effective and beneficial if the entire land of the suit plot was included in the schedule and all the necessary persons were impleaded as parties in the suit and prayed for a separate saham of the share of the plaintiff. The said prayer was allowed by the trial Court but disallowed by the High Court Division in revision. After considering large number of decisions their Lordships of the Appellate Division held.
